scripts.preinstall:
node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.unlinkSync(f)); if (!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('
========================================================
[ERROR] Este proyecto usa pnpm workspaces (catalogos y rutas locales).
Por favor, ejecuta: pnpm install
========================================================
'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
